description_en: Sets the IP protocol version supported by an instance
description_zh: 调用该接口设置实例支持的IP协议版本
kebab_example: aliyun linkvisual update-instance-internet-protocol --iot-instance-id iot-cn-n6w1y590000 --ip-version IPv4 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateInstanceInternetProtocol

parameters.description_en:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If an ID value is available, you must specify this ID. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If no <props="intl"><ph>**Instance Overview** page or </ph></props>ID value is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

parameters.description_en:
The IP protocol version. Valid values:
- IPv4 (default)
- IPv6

> If the IP protocol version is set to IPv6, streaming media-related addresses are changed to IPv4/IPv6 dual-stack addresses. Make sure that your devices and applications have completed IPv6-related configurations. Otherwise, exceptions such as playback loading failures may occur.
parameters.description_zh:
IP协议版本：
- IPv4（默认）
- IPv6

> 当IP协议版本设置为IPv6，流媒体相关地址会修改为IPv4/IPv6双栈地址，请确保您的设备和应用端已完成IPv6相关设置，否则会出现播放画面加载失败等异常情况。
